summary: Rigorous Love will lead two professional learning sessions for the school's Parent Academy, held in both Spanish and English. One covers anti-Black racism within the Raza community, and the other covers restorative justice and the school's approach to discipline. The agreement runs from May 2 to May 30, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Hillary Walker - LIFE Academy
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Hillary Walker, Oakland, CA, for the latter to plan and co-lead a group of students on a public health pathway "post session" through which 20 pathways students will be exposed to a variety of public health experiences linked to their pathway projects, including a week long out of state public health field trip connected to the post session and projects, as stated in Exhibit A of Agreement at Life Academy, for the period of April 1, 2022 through May 26, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $8,000.00.
headline: Pays a consultant up to $8,000 to lead a public health pathway trip for LIFE Academy students
summary: An individual contractor will plan and co-lead a public health pathway "post session" for 20 students at LIFE Academy. It includes a week-long out-of-state public health field trip tied to their pathway projects. The agreement runs from April 1 to May 26, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Earth Team - Skyline High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Earth Team, Richmond, CA, for the latter to provide opportunities for students to engage in real world work experiences through their Sustainable Youth Program, a long term approach to environmental education by working with individual core schools to offer a variety of projects-from short-term class visits to yearlong after school internships-all with a multi-year approach that caters to the unique needs of students and their respective schools with this year’s  projects focusing on waste, watersheds, litter and a brand new urban forestry project, stated in Exhibit A of Agreement,  at Skyline High School, for the period of July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $5,600.00.
headline: Pays Earth Team up to $5,600 for environmental work experiences at Skyline High School
summary: Earth Team will offer students real-world work experience through its Sustainable Youth Program, with projects this year on waste, watersheds, litter and a new urban forestry project at Skyline High School. The agreement runs from July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Global Seed - Oakland High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Global Seed, Oakland, CA, for the latter to manage and coordinate Y-PLAN Oakland action research projects and partnerships between teachers and civic clients by fostering development of key partners and stakeholders within District, the city, and the region, and developing civic work-based learning projects for 2021-22, with this Agreement, as delineated in Exhibit A, to improve student engagement in  Pathways  by empowering students through community-based action research projects that create more relevant and dynamic learning opportunities for Oakland High School, for the period of August 9, 2021 through May 31, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Pays Global Seed up to $10,000 to run student research projects at Oakland High
summary: Global Seed will manage and coordinate Y-PLAN Oakland, which links teachers with civic partners on community-based action research projects. The goal is to make Pathways learning more relevant for students at Oakland High School. The agreement runs from August 9, 2021 to May 31, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Niroga Institute - OPSR Counseling Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Niroga Institute, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a trained instructor to collaborate alongside a credentialed Biology teacher to implement its vision of creating a mindful generation for a more connected and compassionate world as an extension of the NGSS aligned Biology unit about the Stress Response;  promote equity by teaching students and adults trauma-informed dynamic mindfulness, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, via OPSR Counseling Department, for the period of June 2, 2022, through July 8, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $4,500.00.
headline: Pays Niroga Institute up to $4,500 to teach mindfulness alongside a biology unit
summary: Niroga Institute will provide a trained instructor to work with a Biology teacher, extending a biology unit on the stress response by teaching students and adults trauma-informed mindfulness. It is arranged through the OPSR Counseling Department and runs from June 2 to July 8, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Skyline High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Oakland Public Education Fund, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide students with mental health support including regular one-on-one meetings and group sessions for students; coordinate with Coordination of Services Team (COST), Leadership Team, and Culture Team to identify high risk students and initiate connection as well as work as part of emergency mental health response team at Skyline High School, for the period of October 1, 2021, through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $44,560.00.
headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $44,560 for student mental health support at Skyline
summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund will provide one-on-one and group mental health support for students at Skyline High School. It will also work with school teams to identify high-risk students and serve on an emergency mental health response team. The agreement runs from October 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before the board vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Vincent Yu - Franklin Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement  2021-2022 by and between the District and Vincent Yu, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional hours as a community liaison assisting with minor conflict resolution, conducting small group intervention for positive student interactions during the school day, for the period of October 07, 2021 through June 30, 2022, in the additional amount of $5,000.00, increasing the Agreement not to exceed amount from $15,000.00 to $20,000.00.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds $5,000 for a community liaison at Franklin Elementary, raising the contract to $20,000
summary: This amendment adds hours for an individual contractor serving as a community liaison at Franklin Elementary School, who helps with minor conflict resolution and leads small-group work on positive student interactions during the school day. It raises the contract limit from $15,000 to $20,000, and all other terms stay the same. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Our Family Coalition - Network 4
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Our Family Coalition, San Francisco, CA, for the latter to provide a professional training series for all Network 4 principals on a weekly basis for 2 hours, covering topics that include inclusive school trainings that will create more welcoming schools and agencies to serve LGBTQ families and their allies. Additionally, principals will implement more equitable practices to serve lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer families and their allies, via Network 4, for the period of April 1, 2022 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00.
headline: Pays Our Family Coalition up to $5,000 for LGBTQ-inclusive training for Network 4 principals
summary: Our Family Coalition will lead a weekly two-hour training series for all Network 4 principals on making schools more welcoming and equitable for LGBTQ families and their allies. The agreement runs from April 1 to June 30, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - College Summit dba PeerForward - Fremont High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and College Summit, Inc dba PeerForward, Washington, DC, for the latter to conduct a two (2) hour virtual orientation and Leadership Development session and conduct a Training Workshop that focuses on the ins and outs of the college admissions process, master leadership skills, and community organizing techniques; and post-training, assist participants to execute three powerful campaigns to get their peers to college, as stated in Exhibit A of the Agreement, at Fremont High School, for the period of March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $12,000.00.
headline: Pays PeerForward up to $12,000 for a college-going leadership workshop at Fremont High
summary: College Summit, Inc., doing business as PeerForward, will run a virtual leadership orientation and a training workshop on college admissions, leadership and community organizing at Fremont High School. It will then help participants carry out three campaigns to get their peers to college. The agreement runs from March 1 to June 30, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Community Development Finance - Linked Learning Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Community Development Finance, Oakland, CA, for the latter, as directed by District’s Central Academic Recovery lead, to distribute stipends to students participating in select credit recovery programs as part of District’s set of strategies to address COVID learning loss, via Linked Learning Department, for the period of May 16, 2022, through August 8, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $18,000.00.
headline: Pays Community Development Finance up to $18,000 to distribute credit recovery stipends
summary: Community Development Finance will distribute stipends to students in selected credit recovery programs, as directed by the district's Central Academic Recovery lead. The stipends are part of the district's strategies to address COVID learning loss, through the Linked Learning Department. The agreement runs from May 16 to August 8, 2022. The board is ratifying this agreement.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Student Travel - Chicago, Illinois - National Restorative Justice Conference - Edna Brewer Middle School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0199 - Authorization for Approval of Student Travel - by school site Edna Brewer Middle School, for 20 students and 6 adults, as specified in Out of State Field Trip/Excursion Request, attached, to attend the National Community Restorative Justice Conference in Chicago, Illinois, as described in the itinerary, for the period of July 6, 2022 through July 9, 2022, at no cost to the District.
headline: Approves Edna Brewer Middle School trip to a Chicago restorative justice conference at no cost
summary: The Board is asked to approve an out-of-state trip for 20 students and 6 adults from Edna Brewer Middle School to the National Community Restorative Justice Conference in Chicago. The trip would run from July 6 to July 9, 2022. It would be at no cost to the District.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Student Assignment Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Oakland Public Education Fund, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide through Youth Beat at KDOL, a fiscal project of the Fund, the production of 11 videos incorporating school personnel and voices that detail the primary offerings of each site, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Student Assignment Department, for the period of February 1, 2022 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $25,000.00.
headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $25,000 for 11 videos about what each school offers
summary: The district hires the Oakland Public Education Fund, through its Youth Beat at KDOL project, to produce 11 videos featuring school staff and voices that describe what each school site offers. The Student Assignment Department will use them. The work runs from February 1 to June 30, 2022, for no more than $25,000.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Oakland School of the Arts - J-13A Waiver - Loss of Attendance and Instructional Time - COVID-19 Pandemic
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0083 - Approval of Oakland School of the Arts (OSA) J-13A Waiver.
headline: Approves Oakland School of the Arts waiver request over COVID-19 lost attendance and instruction time
summary: The Board is asked to adopt a resolution approving a J-13A waiver for Oakland School of the Arts. According to the item title, the waiver relates to attendance and instructional time lost during the COVID-19 pandemic. The text states no dollar amount.
outcome_action: Adopted

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - FM3 Research - Office of General Counsel
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and FM3 Research, Oakland, CA, for the latter to conduct survey research among District voters on issues related to a potential parcel tax measure, as specified in Exhibit A, (FM3 Proposal December 8, 2021), via Office of the General Counsel, for the period of January 1, 2022 through May 31, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $36,500.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $36,500 for FM3 Research to survey voters on a possible parcel tax
summary: The Board is approving, after the service period began, an agreement with FM3 Research to survey District voters about a possible parcel tax measure. The Office of the General Counsel manages the work, which runs from January 1 to May 31, 2022. The cost is capped at $36,500.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – N. V. Heathorn Company – The Center Foster School Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor of Change Order No. 1 by and between the District and N.V. Heathorn Company, Concord, CA, for the latter to provide additional construction services, which consist of repairing a cart wash duct & ceiling, repairing a leaking steam valve and pipes, replace and remove duroblocks, remove old VFDs from the roof, and fix a broken heat recovery pipe connected to refrigeration equipment, for The Center at Foster Project, in the amount of $16,980.00, increasing the contract price from $16,346.00 to $33,326.00 and extending the term of Agreement from September 23, 2021 through December 31, 2021, by 181 days, to June 30, 2022.
headline: Adds $16,980 and 181 days for N.V. Heathorn's extra repairs at The Center at Foster
summary: This change order adds extra construction work at The Center at Foster project: repairing a cart wash duct and ceiling, a leaking steam valve and pipes, and a broken heat recovery pipe, plus removing old equipment from the roof. It raises the contract price from $16,346 to $33,326 and extends the end date by 181 days, to June 30, 2022.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1 Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Data Services, Inc. – Various Sites Door Entry System Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1 of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Data Media Services, Inc., Stockton, CA, granting time extension for completion for the Various Sites Door Entry System Project, from December 11, 2021 through February 14, 2022, by 199 days, to September 1, 2022. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Extends the door entry system project deadline by 199 days for Data Media Services, at no added cost
summary: This change order gives Data Media Services, Inc. more time to finish the Various Sites Door Entry System Project, moving the completion date by 199 days to September 1, 2022. The text states no added money. All other terms of the agreement stay the same.
